meaning: the station has the Map Creator facts about it the core cannot carry: the product type and the allowed modes, the queues that serve it, the internal transport graph over its own parts, and the docking bays it offers

schema.$comment: Open to fields a newer producer adds (SPEC §9). Derived from `records.rs`'s field map by `vocabulary()`; edit the map, not this.

entity_id.description: One entity of this document, by identity. A declared identity is a UUID; a derived one is its root UUID and the generator's key path, which nothing in a converted document produces.
entity_id.title: entity_id

entity_ids.description: Entities of this document by identity, in the order the Map Creator file states them.
entity_ids.title: entity_ids

legacy_value.description: A legacy value the dump wrote, kept verbatim in whatever JSON kind it wrote it. It states no type on purpose: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and correcting a kind here would be the converter deciding what the site meant.
legacy_value.title: legacy_value

placed_legacy_values.description: Legacy values a Map Creator list holds that named nothing in the dump, each with `at`, its place in the list counting from zero, and `value`, the value verbatim.
placed_legacy_values.title: placed_legacy_values

schema.description: the station has the Map Creator facts about it the core cannot carry: the product type and the allowed modes, the queues that serve it, the internal transport graph over its own parts, and the docking bays it offers

allowed_modes.description: Map Creator's `allowed_modes`, carried as the export states it.

associations.description: Map Creator's `associations`, carried as the export states it.

at_cell.description: The cell Map Creator's `location` names, by entity identity. The export writes the legacy spelling back from the identity, so no display string is load-bearing here (SPEC §2).

at_cell_unresolved.description: Map Creator's `location` verbatim, present only when the cell it names is not in this dump. Never corrected and never dropped: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and the ledger counts it as a dangling source reference.

blocks.description: The blocks, in order Map Creator's `blocks` names, by entity identity. The export writes the legacy spelling back from the identity, so no display string is load-bearing here (SPEC §2).

blocks_unresolved.description: The entries of Map Creator's `blocks` that name a block that is not in this dump, each verbatim with its place in the list the file states. The entries that resolved are references in their own order, and the export writes each of these back at its place among them. Present only when an entry named nothing.

docking_stations.description: Map Creator's `docking_stations`, carried as the export states it.

eligible_system.description: Map Creator's `eligible_system`, carried as the export states it.

orchestrator.description: Map Creator's `orchestrator`, carried as the export states it.

pick_cell.description: The cell Map Creator's `pick_position` names, by entity identity. The export writes the legacy spelling back from the identity, so no display string is load-bearing here (SPEC §2).

pick_cell_unresolved.description: Map Creator's `pick_position` verbatim, present only when the cell it names is not in this dump. Never corrected and never dropped: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and the ledger counts it as a dangling source reference.

pick_direction.description: Map Creator's `pick_direction`, carried as the export states it.

put_docking_positions.description: Map Creator's `put_docking_positions`, carried as the export states it.

queue_cells.description: The cells, in order Map Creator's `queue_barcodes` names, by entity identity. The export writes the legacy spelling back from the identity, so no display string is load-bearing here (SPEC §2).

queue_cells_unresolved.description: The entries of Map Creator's `queue_barcodes` that name a cell that is not in this dump, each verbatim with its place in the list the file states. The entries that resolved are references in their own order, and the export writes each of these back at its place among them. Present only when an entry named nothing.

role.description: Map Creator's `type`: the product identity of the station, which `station.role` beside this repeats where a core kind was derivable. Absent when the record states no `type`.

runtime.description: What was happening at the site when the export was written, as the export wrote it. SPEC §1 separates a world from what is happening in it, so this is here to be dropped by a policy that decides to rather than lost by a converter that forgot — the round trip writes it back.

status.description: Map Creator's `status`, carried as the export states it.

url.description: Map Creator's `pps_url`, carried as the export states it.

served_by.description: The blocks that serve this station, by entity identity, in the order `entities.blocks` lists them. The core's station component names nothing.

served_by_unresolved.description: The entries of Map Creator's `entities.blocks` that name a block that is not in this dump, each verbatim with its place in the list the file states. The entries that resolved are references in their own order, and the export writes each of these back at its place among them. Present only when an entry named nothing.

system.description: Map Creator's `system`, carried as the export states it.
